title: Rowan Finding
description: A single vulnerability finding produced by the Rowan SAST scanner.

file.description: Path to the file containing the vulnerability.

line.description: 1-indexed start line number. 0 for dependency (SCA) findings that are not tied to a source line.

engine.description: Scan engine that produced this finding.

evidence_tier.description: What was actually computed to support this finding. 'taint-flow': a source-to-sink dataflow, attached as taint_flow. 'taint-flow-unresolved': a trace enters a service call whose returned value was not resolved; the finding is capped below HIGH pending review. 'engine': model-file opcode or authz-graph analysis. 'source-context': legacy tier accepted for older reports; new scans do not emit it because file context is not source-to-sink evidence. 'self-evident': the matched text is the whole claim (hardcoded secret, weak crypto); no dataflow asserted. 'pattern-only': an unverified pattern match. A hypothesis, not a fact, capped below HIGH for dataflow-claiming categories. 'presence': artifact capability inventory without a malicious-operation claim. 'authorization-gap': a static guard gap; access policy/runtime impact are not proven, so excluded from the confirmed view.

authorization_requirement.description: Declared model policy or unverified when a model/operation cannot be resolved.

object_use.description: Conservative use classification for an object authorization guard gap.

model_identity.description: Resolved repository module and model class used for explicit policy matching.

rule_class.description: 'vulnerability' for findings that assert a bug; 'inventory' for attack-surface/hygiene presence signals (e.g. an API being present) with no dataflow claim.

taint_flow.description: Source-to-sink dataflow path. Present for taint and crossfile findings.

reachability.description: SCA reachability verdict for a dependency finding, e.g. 'reachable' or 'unreachable'. Null when not computed.

reachability_evidence.description: Supporting evidence for the reachability verdict.

vuln_func_source.description: Source snippet of the vulnerable function, for SCA reachability findings.

direct.description: Whether the vulnerable dependency is a direct dependency (true) or transitive (false). Null when not applicable.

dependency_chain.description: Path of package names from a direct dependency down to the vulnerable transitive dependency. Null/absent when not applicable.

version_indeterminate.description: True when the installed version of a dependency could not be determined precisely.

fixed_version.description: Version that fixes the vulnerability, if known.

epss.description: EPSS exploit prediction score for the CVE, if available.

epss_percentile.description: EPSS percentile for the CVE, if available.

phantom_dependency.description: True when the vulnerable package is imported but not declared in the project's dependency manifest.

malicious.description: True when the dependency itself is flagged as a known-malicious package, not just vulnerable.

snippet.description: Source code snippet at this node.

sink.description: Where the dangerous function is called.

intermediate.description: Intermediate hops between source and sink.
